newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Wah Tak Fung IPO to begin on Sept 17 - sources.
newsitem.headline: HK's Wah Tak Fung IPO to begin on Sept 17 - sources.

text.p: The initial public offering of Wah Tak Fung Holdings Ltd will take place September 17-20 with dealing to begin on September 30, market sources close to the underwriters said on Friday.
The Hong Kong-based property group is expected to issue 138 million new shares at HK$1.88 per share, raising about HK$260 million to fund its property development projects, sources said.
Wah Tak Fung's portfolio, comprising 84 percent office property and 16 percent residential, is valued at HK$2.565 billion, giving a net asset value of HK$2.76 per share, they said.
Crosby Capital is the sponsor of the issue.
